description: Authoritative seeded-defect catalog. Each entry pairs a workbook + cell with the rule that should fire, the mode (DET vs HEUR), whether the check is value-dependent (requires recalc), and notes. Every finding the auditor reports against these workbooks should map to an entry here; anything else is a false positive to investigate.
